# External data backbone

**Provider:** US Environmental Protection Agency  
**Dataset:** 2025 Automotive Trends — MY2024 Fuel Economy & Technology Data  
**Source:** https://www.epa.gov/automotive-trends/explore-automotive-trends-data  
**DOI/reference:** 2025 EPA Automotive Trends Report  
**License/terms:** US government public data; review EPA data notes

Advertised source scale: vehicle-specific model-year 2024 fuel-economy and technology attributes.

Run `./data/external/fetch_public_data.ps1` on an internet-connected Windows machine to refresh the public source. Offline acceptance uses repository reference evidence and never relabels that fixture as external observation.
